definition: Team guide specifies RAG-01 through RAG-12 and coverage topics, but no per-ID definitions. These are this audit's explicit operational groupings; groups may overlap and are not additive test counts.

cases.title: Rental exact retrieval and Evidence contract
cases.expected: Exact Courts source and six-field Evidence; shared schema valid, no legal applicability inferred

cases.title: Consumer exact retrieval
cases.input: Consumer CASE_PERSONAL_PURPOSE and existing checked mapping
cases.expected: Correct CASE source and citation validation; deterministic isolated results

cases.title: Landlord and agent source separation
cases.input: Rental CEA_AGENCY_AGREEMENT versus SCT mapping; consumer requests rental-only agency rule; wrong-case template
cases.expected: Requested IDs determine exact evidence; no accidental cross-case/channel mapping or frontend/legal decision

cases.title: No results and unknown facts
cases.input: Empty/unknown/wrong-case Rule IDs, invalid requests and facts containing null/unknown/false
cases.expected: NO_RESULTS for absent mappings, ERROR for malformed input, no partial Evidence, facts preserved

cases.title: Bad Evidence and citation rejection
cases.input: Forged/mismatched IDs, URLs, source metadata, duplicate/partial/extra citations and empty claims
cases.expected: Typed CitationValidationError; no unsupported citation batch accepted

cases.title: Unreviewed and quarantined source exclusion
cases.input: Coherently downgraded review states; persistent operational quarantine; already-retrieved Evidence
cases.expected: Affected evidence unavailable across repository instances; prior citations invalidated; unrelated sources remain usable

cases.title: Current versions and review identity
cases.input: Version transitions, stale citations, current excerpt mismatch and synthetic historical page fingerprint
cases.expected: No stale cache; only current version/time/reviewer proof accepted, historical review cannot override current mismatch

cases.title: Conflicting proof and quarantine history
cases.input: Conflicting current review fingerprints; deleted quarantine entry/history, altered reason or orphan release
cases.expected: Reject ambiguous proof and contradictory state; ERROR/no Evidence, prior citations rejected; no silent repair

cases.title: Unavailable or malformed source storage
cases.input: Synthetic live outage/changed page/missing excerpt, malformed files or corrupt operational JSON
cases.expected: Affected source blocked or retrieval ERROR; no stale/fabricated evidence and no implicit source approval

cases.title: Deterministic rebuild/import and reload
cases.input: Two checked snapshot exports, new repository instance and invalid candidate export
cases.expected: Same bytes/results; canonical files unchanged, no runtime activation, invalid rebuild preserves old snapshot and quarantine
cases.limitation: Exact Rule-ID lookup has no FTS5/vector index; applicable rebuild is validated snapshot import and fresh reload, not an invented index rebuild.

cases.title: Shared sources and complete mapping coverage
cases.input: Real SCT_CLAIM_AMOUNT in both cases; synthetic shared Rule-ID alias; a multi-passage rule
cases.expected: Canonical Evidence consistent across cases, deduplicated with all requested IDs; incomplete coverage refused

cases.title: Update rollback, state writes and explicit recovery
cases.input: Invalid/same-version candidate updates, quarantine carried into new bundle, changed source release, write failure and writer lock
cases.expected: Old binding/state preserved on failure; changed sources stay blocked; recovery requires fresh matching proof; no automatic release or activation
